name: publish-routed-review-receipt-contract
title: Publish routed review receipt contract
description: Publish a versioned, exact-head remote review routing contract for the command pack's unified sd-review surface that accepts a privacy-bounded local summary, enforces independent-review floors, and dispatches Copilot or external backends by explainable cost-quality policy.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Publishes the router-owned v1 contract before platypeeps/sd-ai-command-pack task 07-22-integrate-routed-review-backends begins remote consumption. It aligns with parent 07-22-streamline-sd-skill-workflows and the shared exact-head eligibility gate: every new head gets a distinct router decision and receipt, while a verified bookkeeping-only successor may route to none only through router auto policy. A caller-local skipped successor receipt provides zero confidence and cannot replace the router's own trusted GitHub comparison. The router remains noninteractive, never runs local providers or PR checkout code, and exposes setup/dispatch evidence that distinguishes optional absence from broken or ambiguous routing without a fallback request. Hand off schemas, fixtures, release or commit identity, and pilot evidence explicitly.
